features: WIRELESS CONNECTIVITY: Keyboard Connects Via Bluetooth Only (No 2.4GHz USB Receiver) & Mouse Supports Both Bluetooth + 2.4GHz Wireless (USB Receiver Included)
MULTI-DEVICE COMPATIBLE: Seamlessly works with Android, and iOS across smartphones, tablets, laptops, Windows, macOS and desktops for versatile everyday use.
RECHARGEABLE BATTERY: Built-in rechargeable battery charges via Type-C cable — up to 40 hours of use without backlight and up to 3 hours with backlight, eliminating the need for disposable batteries.
ULTRA SLIM & PORTABLE DESIGN: At just 6mm thin, the lightweight and compact keyboard is easy to carry wherever you go, making it ideal for travel and on-the-go productivity.

description: Upgrade your workspace with this Wireless Mouse & Keyboard Kit, the keyboard connects only via Bluetooth and the mouse supports both Bluetooth and 2.4GHz USB receiver for flexible connectivity, this kit lets you effortlessly switch between your smartphone, tablet, laptop, and desktop — compatible with Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS platforms. The ultra-slim keyboard measures just 6mm in thickness, making it significantly more compact than a standard keyboard, and is lightweight enough to carry wherever you go — ideal for travel and on-the-go use. The built-in rechargeable battery charges conveniently via Type-C, offering up to 40 hours of uninterrupted use without backlight and up to 3 hours with backlight. Low-profile keys ensure quiet, comfortable typing, while the high-precision mouse delivers smooth and accurate navigation. Setup is quick and easy — simply turn on, pair your device, and you're connected. Package includes 1 wireless keyboard, 1 wireless mouse, 1 Type-C charging cable, and 1 user manual. NOTE : Keyboard Does Not Support 2.4GHz Wireless Connection, It's Only Connect Via Bluetooth.
